references.title: DWDS: her
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Adverb 'von dort (nach hier)'; Etymologie: ahd. hera, an old adverb

notes.rationale: von den Dünen her, the direction toward the speaker; von ... her is the preposition von and this adverb, no unit of its own. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root her alone.
